issue.title: Processes are sometimes restarted after `pm stop`

repository.name: pm2
repository.description: Node.js Production Process Manager with a built-in Load Balancer.

issue.body:
Sometimes after `pm2 stop all` processes may be restarted. [See this gist](https://gist.github.com/morkai/d977daeb6b9b46ab8fc6) (10 running processes, after `pm2 stop all` the `test-1` process is online and its restart count is 1).

You can see that when it works, the process enters `God.handleExit()` with status `stopping` and when it doesn't work the status is `stopped`, because sometimes [`God.stopProcessId()` finishes](https://github.com/Unitech/PM2/blob/development/lib/God/ActionMethods.js#L257) before [the process emits the `close` event](https://github.com/Unitech/PM2/blob/development/lib/God.js#L242).

Windows 8.1 64-bit, Node.js v0.10.35, pm2 0.12.6 & development.
Couldn't reproduce it on Ubuntu 14.

issue.title: Error on gracefulReload when app handling long requests?

repository.name: pm2
repository.description: Node.js Production Process Manager with a built-in Load Balancer.

issue.body:
We have the same process deployed on two separate machines, node v0.12.7 and pm2 0.14.7 on a 4-core machine in AWS.

We've recently started using 'startOrGracefulReload' to restart these apps, they are both serving as an internal api. The 1st one eventually restarts in under 2 minutes but it is used for fast queries in production. The 2nd one handles much longer queries, however, such that it really can't be graceful. When pm2 hits this limit everything seems to go to hell, and it tries to update itself (?!). When I first discovered the process was down, I noticed that my processes were all gone and each replaced with a 'pm2 update' command.

issue.title: Start pm2 without log streaming and strange kill ESRCH error

repository.name: pm2
repository.description: Node.js Production Process Manager with a built-in Load Balancer.

issue.body:
Hi,

firstly, thanks for pm2.

I want to ask few questions.
1. Is there a way to run pm2 with `--no-daemon` flag and without log streaming? I log into one file with `--merge-logs` flag so it is unnecessary for me to log to `stdout` concurrently. 
2. Is there a way to split log output from application and from pm2 into separated log files?
3. I am encountering strange error while runnnig app. My application is running in docker container, and this container periodically dies because of this PM2 error:

```
14:18:04 PM2 -softReload- Old worker disconnected
14:18:04 PM2 Stopping app:user-fe-api id:_old_15
14:18:04 PM2 190 pid can not be killed { [Error: kill ESRCH] code: 'ESRCH', errno: 'ESRCH', syscall: 'kill' }
```

Is there any advice what to do with this error?

I am running on `iojs-2.3.3` and `pm2-0.14.3`.

Thanks for your reply.

O.

body:
